ZONING LOT AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ZONING LOT AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this“Agreement"),made as of the Zday of Ay 2011, by and between HAG REALTY LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 250 West 26th Street, New York, New York 10001 ("Seller"), and CHELSEA W26 LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 37 West 65th Street, 2nd Floor, New York, New York 10023 ("Developer"). RECITALS: A.Seller is the fee owner of certain land described onSchedule_A annexed hereto, which land is designated as Lot 64 in Block 775 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the “"Tax Map"), and known by the street address 250 West 26th Street (such land, “Seller's Land"), together with the improvements now or hereafter located on Seller's Land ("Seller's Improvements") (Seller's Land and Seller's Improvements are collectively referred to as “Seller's Property"). As of the date hereof, Seller's Improvements consist of a four-story building (such building, as the same exists as of the date hereof, “Seller's Existing Building"). B.Developer is the fee owner of certain land described onSchedule B annexed hereto, such land being designated as Lots 4, 69, 77, 78, 79 and 80 in Block 775 on the Tax Map and known by the street addresses 306Eighth Avenue,252 West 26th Street,262West 26th Street, 264 West 26th Street, 320 Eighth Avenue and 318 Eighth Avenue, respectively (such land,"Developer's Land"). C. Developer may (but in no event shall be obligated to) renovate improvements now located on Developer's Land or construct a new building or buildings and improvements or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto, whether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, and whether upon Developer's Land or other adjacent land, being herein referred to as “Developer's Proposed Building,” (Developer's Land and Developer's Proposed Building are collectively referred to as "Developer'sProperty"). D. Pursuant to a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated as of the date hereof between Seller and Developer (the “Declaration"), Seller's Land and Developer's Land have been merged and combined into a single zoning lot (such single zoning lot, as the same maybe'enlarged or otherwisemodifiedfrom time to time,beinghereinreferred to as the "Combined Zoning Lot"). The Declaration is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording in the Office of the City Register of the City of New. York (the "Register's Office"). E. As used herein, the term “Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean certain rights, as determined by the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961 (as amended to date and as the same may hereafter be amended, the “Zoning Resolution") - 1- HF6363517v.6#12056/0009
